P4.evidence: Comprehensive. Past attempts surfaced in detail — dietitians, weighing every item of food, Pilates, weightlifting, multiple diets. What happened was explicit: 'I followed what they wrote religiously, to the point that I was weighing my food, which is kind of crazy, didn't help.' Why it does not stick was probed and confirmed: 'Is that what you've been finding with your weight loss journey?' — 'Kind of, yeah. And she named the gap herself in the form of a question the offer could answer directly: 'is there anything that I can do that would make it a little easier? objection_plays.detail: Script gap and the most consequential one on this call: no clinical screening or clearance path. The prospect disclosed a cervical disc problem, knees that prevent running, and a father disabled by eighteen spinal cord operations which she attributes partly to shared genetics — and stated that she refuses surgery as a matter of principle. She is already performing halos and around-the-world movements, which take a loaded bell around the head and neck, unsupervised and self-taught from videos. Nothing in the playbook prompts a clearance question, and what she received instead was the assurance that shoulder and knee problems disappear two to three months into the programme.

Second gap — the prospect who has already succeeded alone. She has lost 32 lb without medication or drugs, follows a carnivore diet, walks daily in a weighted vest and describes herself as able to follow instructions to the letter. Her stated need is not structure or discipline, both of which she demonstrably has; it is a method that responds to a 50-year-old body and costs less of her life to maintain. The playbook's discovery is built around prospects who cannot stick to things, and it has no branch for one whose adherence is already excellent and whose complaint is the maintenance burden.

No money, timing, spouse, think-about-it or fear objection appears in the captured portion because the recording ends before the price. Objection-play performance on this call cannot be assessed and should be excluded from any rollup rather than scored as clean.

notes: Assess this scorecard with the truncation in mind — roughly the second half of the call is missing, so P6 and P11 are marked not_applicable rather than scored. Within what is captured, discovery was strong: P2, P3 and P4 all ran close to the book and the trigger question produced the most powerful why in the batch. And then P5 was skipped entirely, with a disabled father and a refusal of surgery sitting in the open where the consequence frame should have been. Second coaching point, and it recurs across this rep: a cervical disc plus a family history of degenerative spinal disease in a prospect already doing loaded overhead work should stop the presentation for a clearance question, not prompt a reassurance that injuries go away.
